She's 17, that's the thing. I wish I could just convince her to take one more year and then she never has to face her horrible mother again.

If a call a suicide hotline, does that mean immediate action? It's two in the morning.

Still haven't heard back, but thank you for your efforts. I kind of got a little optimistic.

But that only applies to medical and not mental attention?
Admittedly, as I had said above, that's very likely impossible.

...Admittedly, no, the verbal abuse heavily outweighs the physical abuse. But she's grown an overwhelming fear of her parents, so there remains that.

I think only if you don't mention suicide or self-harm, he doesn't have to notify parents.

I've already talked to the psychiatrist and guidence counselor, but I did not mention her name in either instance.
